 COMMON ORDER [Order of the Court was made by R.SURESH KUMAR, J.] Since the issue raised in these Writ Petitions as well as Writ Appeal is related to Chithirai Festival of Arulmigu Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple, Madurai and Arulmigu Kallazhagar Temple and as the issues raised in these cases are interlinked, with the consent of the learned counsel for the parties, all these cases were heard together. 
2.Insofar as W.P.(MD)No.9476 of 2024 and W.A.(MD)No.819 of 2024 are concerned, those two cases are taken up along with other Writ Petitions for the purpose of passing the present order,
which would be an interim order in those cases ie., W.P.(MD)No.9476 of 2024 and W.A.(MD)No.819 of 2024. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.(MD) Nos.8675 and 8687 of 2024 3.Insofar as W.P.(MD)Nos.8675 and 8687 of 2024 are concerned, these Writ Petitions are disposed of by this order itself. 
4.In W.P.(MD)Nos.8675 and 8687 of 2024, we have passed interim orders on 08.04.2024 and 18.04.2024. 
5.Pursuant to the said orders, especially, order dated 18.04.2024, we have visited the spot, where Lord Kallazhagar descending into Vaigai River in the early hours on 23.04.2024 as well as the surrounding area, yesterday ie., on 21.04.2024.
6.The District Administration headed by the District Collector, Commissioner of Police and other police officials, Commissioner of Madurai Corporation and his officials, the officials of Public Works Department, Fire and Rescue Service Department, Health Department and Water Resources Department and also the temple authorities of Arulmigu Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple and Arulmigu Kallazhagar Temple, the learned Additional Advocate General, the learned Government Pleader, the learned Government counsel and others were present.

5 7.The elaborate arrangements, which are made for the grand festival of Kallazhagar descending into Vaigai River, had been explained to us by the stakeholders concerned. After having inspected the places, we felt that some more directions are necessarily to be given to the District Administration,
Police and Civic Administration and the temple authorities for the smooth and secured conducting of the festival. 
8.As the festival of Celestial marriage at Arulmigu Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple and Car festival had been over by today (22.04.2024), the only major festival left is the Lord Kallazhagar descending into Vaigai River, which is scheduled to be conducted by tomorrow (23.04.2024) at 05.50 a.m., to 6.10 a.m. In the said festival by taking into account of the earlier year's statistics, the District Administration and the temple authorities expect that there will be gathering of devotees to the extent of 7 to 10 lakhs. 
9.If any festival is being conducted, where the expected devotees would be touching one million, it will be very noted festival not only of the State but also throughout the Country. Therefore, such a mammoth festival is to be conducted with utmost care and precautions in all respects. 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.(MD) Nos.8675 and 8687 of 2024 10.In this context, we already recorded as per the instructions given by the Administration concerned that how much police persons would be deployed for security purposes. Insofar as the arrangements, that are made in the festival site at Vaigai River are concerned, we were told by the authorities concerned that this year both in the northern bank and southern bank of Vaigai River,
new footsteps have been constructed very recently, which are put to use for public. Using the staircase, public can enter into the Vaigai River from where they can witness the event of the Lord Kallazhagar descending into Vaigai River conveniently. 
11.This arrangement for the first time this year they have made only in order to manage the crowd,
as several lakhs of people will throng in a particular spot in Vaigai River at the time of the Lord Kallazhagar descending into Vaigai River. 
12.In this context, we have also to point out that for the purpose of this festival, water has been released from Vaigai Dam, which already reached Madurai and there had been water flowing, which,
according to the Public Works Department and Water Resource Department, is 1000 cubic feet. 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.(MD) Nos.8675 and 8687 of 2024 13.However, on seeing the flow of water, we felt that if that much of water is permitted to flow during this Kallazhagar festival time, especially, when the Lord Kallazhagar descending into Vaigai River, where lakhs of people may make use of the river bed, that may not be conducive for those,
especially, women and children to have a free standing on the River. 
14.Therefore, yesterday (21.04.2024), we orally suggested that the quantity of water being released can be reduced to the optimum level, which would be decided by the authorities concerned.

6 15.Pursuant to the said suggestion, today (22.04.2024), the learned Additional Advocate General and the learned Government Pleader appearing for the official respondents / District Administration, on instructions, would submit that the water flow has been reduced to 400 cubic feet, which would be, according to them, the optimum level and the same has to be maintained for the purpose of conducting the festival, as the devotees would expect that water flow for their worshipping purposes.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.(MD) Nos.8675 and 8687 of 2024 16.That apart, how medical facilities are provided in and around the spot, how drinking water facilities are provided throughout the en-route and also in the spot and how the crowd management will be undertaken by the police force by placing temporary barricades , all have been explained to us. 
17.That apart, the Deputy Director of Tamil Nadu Fire and Rescue Services, Southern Region,
Madurai, has filed a report, where inter-alia, he has stated the following:-
During these festival days (21.04.2024, 22.04.2024 & 23.04.2024) lakhs of devotees would witness the festival. 
Considering the devotees and general public safety, it is proposed to conduct standby duties by deploying 13 fire vehicles (Emergency Rescue Tender, Fire Water Tenders, Fire Water Bowzers,
Ambulance, Fire Bullet Squad) with 212 fire fighters under the supervision of Dy.Director Southern Region, Madurai along with 2 District Officers, 4 Assistant District Officers. It is further informed that Fire & Rescue Services Department have fully equipped and mobilised sufficient forces to carry out the bandobast standby duties for the Madurai Chithirai Festival 2024. It is submitted that this status report along with the annexe Standby Duty Scheme and Action Plan for the kind perusal and orders.

Nos.8675 and 8687 of 2024 18.Insofar as on the line live wires crossing across the en-route, the Lord Kallazhagar descending into Vaigai River are concerned, it was, in fact, inspected by us and the District Administration and stakeholders have explained that those live wires had been put in the maximum height and tightened. Therefore, that would not create any hindrance to the free moving of Kallazhagar through the en-route. 
19.In fact, emergency medical camp has been set up at Theni Anantham Complex, where a group of Doctors with emergency medicines are kept ready to meet out any medical emergency. Apart from that, if any further medical assistance is required, the Rajaji Medical College Hospital since is located nearby, such medical care also would be immediately given. 24.Relying upon this report, the learned Standing Counsel for the Executive Officer of the Kallazhagar Temple has submitted that insofar as the water spreading event is concerned, it is one of the Nerthikadan and also it is the ceremony being followed from time memorial. Several thousands of devotees would take this kind of Nerthikadan during the Kallazhagar festival every year. 
25.Stating this, the learned Standing Counsel would further submit that sometime in the name of Nerthikadan by spreading water on Lord Kallazhagar or on the devotees, pressure pumps were fitted by some few people. Those people may not be the true devotees, but can only be branded as miscreants. Like that some of them instead of spreading pure water, sometime they spread colored K.K.Ramesh vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 22 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18093591/

If these kind of water mixed with any other things as stated above https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.(MD) Nos.8675 and 8687 of 2024 or poured either on the devotees or on the Lord Kallazhagar and the priests, who are standing along with the Lord Kallazhagar during the entire procession, that will harm the devotees as well as the priests. Therefore, that kind of practice by the very miscreants should be prohibited and prevented, he contended. 
26.Apart from this small complaint, there had been no other complaint with regard to the water spreading ceremony, which is one of the Nerthikadan being undertaken by thousands of devotees during the Kallazhagar Festival. 
27.In the report, it has also been stated that insofar as the direction that had been given by the Writ Court in W.P.(MD)No.6948 of 2024, dated 28.03.2024 is concerned, it is practically difficult for executing such directions by the temple authorities. 
28.The learned Standing Counsel would further contend that since this Court intervened against the order passed by the Writ Court dated 03.04.2024, as there had been only 7 persons registered,
seeking such permission for water spreading, therefore, it was a very lukewarm response to register themselves for https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.(MD) Nos.8675 and 8687 of 2024 such water spreading event by devotees, as thousands of devotees would normally involve in that exercise,
whereas less than 10 people wanted to register their name. Therefore, it goes against the wishes of entire devotees. This is also one of the issue that had been brought to our notice by the temple authorities by the report filed by the Executive Officer. 
29.We have taken judicial notice of the same.
